_comment: Editor-side property metadata for properties the header scanner (Tools/Export/scan_property_meta.py) cannot see, in three flavours: (a) Blueprint-defined properties that exist on runtime BP subclasses with NO C++ UPROPERTY anywhere in Source/; (b) JSON-compiled properties whose owning class declares no UPROPERTY at all and instead parses the raw `properties` object at load (the AI2 ScpBehavior/ScpSkill/ScpPerception definitions); (c) properties whose UPROPERTY exists only on an unmerged TSIC branch while tsic-default-mod already ships data using them — this is structural, not temporary: the mod's `beta` data deliberately tracks several in-flight game branches at once (metahuman, qa/farming), so a full re-export from TSIC main can never cover them and this file is their correct home until those branches land. Pack-level directives (`extends`, `abstract`) do NOT belong here — they are class-agnostic and are skipped by PACK_DIRECTIVE_PROPS in src/persistence/schemaDriftValidator.ts. refresh-schema.mjs merges these into property-meta.json after the scan, so they survive refreshes and don't show as schema drift; scanner keys always win, so an entry becomes an inert no-op once the scanner can see the property. Keys are Class.snake_property (bare class name, no U/F prefix); bools get both the b_-prefixed and bare spellings the scanner emits. Entry shape matches the scanner's output. Leave clamp_min/clamp_max null unless the C++ really declares them — they drive live editor bounds.

PlantableDefinition.plant_slot_offsets.tooltip: Local-space position of each plant slot (pot base). One entry per unit of queue capacity; the last entry repeats if the queue outgrows the array.

PlantableDefinition.plant_root_offset.tooltip: Offset from a slot position to where the plant mesh roots (the dirt line).

PlantableDefinition.slot_pot_mesh.tooltip: Optional pot mesh rendered at every slot position, for planters whose own mesh doesn't model the pots (wheelbarrow tray, hydroponics shelf).

ScpBehaviorDefinition.roots.tooltip: JSON-only: ordered root-state when-lists, first match top-to-bottom wins. Compiled to FScpCompiledBehavior::RootEntries by ScpAi2::CompileBehaviorJson (ScpBehaviorGraph.cpp:757); UScpBehaviorDefinition declares no UPROPERTY for it.

ScpBehaviorDefinition.root_eval_interval.tooltip: JSON-only: seconds between root-selection passes (events force an immediate pass); defaults to 0.2 when absent or <= 0. Read at ScpBehaviorGraph.cpp:751.

ScpSkillDefinition.states.tooltip: JSON-only: state list hosted under a synthetic root for skills. Read at ScpBehaviorGraph.cpp:708; UScpSkillDefinition declares no UPROPERTY for it.

ScpSkillDefinition.inputs.tooltip: JSON-only: skill input variable declarations, name → type. Parsed by FBehaviorCompiler::ParseVarDecls (ScpBehaviorGraph.cpp:692).

ScpPerceptionDefinition.day_section_over.tooltip: JSON-only: per-day-section overrides of the perception channels, keyed by day-section name. Read at ScpPerceptionDefinition.cpp:87.
